metadata.description: Workframe: a product-work system for Claude Code. Install workframe-launcher to create or onboard projects; each project gets the core plugin with 4 agents, 36 skills, hooks and rules.

plugins.name: workframe-launcher
plugins.description: Workframe launcher: the one command that starts everything. Creates a new Workframe project or onboards an existing one — asks about your product, proposes a module structure, scaffolds it, subscribes the project to the core plugin, and verifies the install. Install this once per machine; it installs core into each project for you.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Workframe core plugin: 4 baseline agents (PM / Dev / QA / Prompt-Eng), 36 skills (13 domain + 8 system/maintenance + 8 docs/publishing + 7 modules-system), an 11-stage hook pipeline, 4 auto-loaded rules, and the modules/ documentation system that keeps requirements and code in sync.
